description: This file implements a BackportManager for handling bytecode version backports in PyTorch's JIT mobile compatibility layer. It includes utility functions for copying and writing model archives, updating bytecode versions, and specific functions for backporting models between different bytecode versions (v5 to v4, v6 to v5, etc.). It also registers these functions in a BackportManager class to facilitate version conversions.

classes.name: BackportManager
classes.description: Manages registration and execution of backport functions for different bytecode versions.

methods.name: registerBytecodeBackportFunction
methods.description: Registers a backport function for a specific bytecode version.

methods.name: hasBytecodeBackportFunction
methods.description: Checks if a backport function is registered for a specific version.

methods.name: backport
methods.description: Performs backporting of a model stream from one bytecode version to another using registered functions.
